{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the column names to confirm the correct response variable
print('Columns:', trial_df.columns.tolist())

# Check the value counts of the 'responded' column
print('\nValue counts of responded:', trial_df['responded'].value_counts())

# Compute response rate by site using 'responded' as the response variable
response_rates = trial_df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean() * 100
print('\nResponse rates by site:\n', response_rates)

# Find the site with the highest response rate
highest_site = response_rates.idxmax()
highest_rate = response_rates.max()

print(f'\nHighest response rate: {highest_site} with {highest_rate:.2f}%')"}
